title: A Phase 1 Study of QLS2416 Injection in Participants With Autoimmune Diseases
off: A Phase 1 Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Immunogenicity, and Efficacy of QLS2416 Injection in Participants With Autoimmune Diseases
sponsor: Shanghai Qilu Pharmaceutical Research and Development Center LTD
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics (PK), immunogenicity, and efficacy of QLS2416 injection in participants with autoimmune diseases (AID).

The main questions it aims to answer are:

• What is the safety and tolerability profile of single and multiple ascending doses of QLS2416 injection?

This study consists of two parts. Participants will receive QLS2416 injection via subcutaneous administration in dose-escalation part and dose-expansion part. Safety assessments will be conducted throughout the study. Efficacy assessments will vary by disease indication.
desc:
This is a Phase 1, multicenter, open-label, dose-escalation and dose-expansion study of QLS2416 injection in participants with autoimmune diseases.

The study consists of two parts:

1. Dose Escalation Part:

   * Up to 42 participants with active SLE, RA, or pSS will be enrolled across up to 7 dose cohorts (0.025 mg to 6.0 mg).
   * A Safety Monitoring Committee (SMC) will review safety, PK, pharmacodynamic (PD), and efficacy data before dose escalation.
2. Dose Expansion Part:

   * Approximately 24 participants with SLE and 10 participants with dcSSc will be enrolled
   * Multiple dosing may be administered based on emerging safety, efficacy, and PK data.

QLS2416 is a novel biologic agent being developed for the treatment of B-cell-mediated autoimmune diseases. The study will characterize the safety, tolerability, PK, PD, immunogenicity, and preliminary efficacy of QLS2416 in participants with active autoimmune diseases who have had inadequate response or intolerance to standard therapies.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Male or female participants aged 18 to 70 years (inclusive) at the time of ICF signing.
2. Able to understand and voluntarily sign the written informed consent form (ICF).
3. For SLE: Diagnosed with SLE per 2019 EULAR/ACR classification criteria; disease duration ≥ 24 weeks; SLEDAI-2K ≥ 4; inadequate response or intolerance to glucocorticoids combined with at least one immunosuppressant or biologic agent.
4. For RA: Diagnosed with RA per 2010 ACR/EULAR classification criteria; disease duration ≥ 12 weeks; DAS28-CRP ≥ 3.2; TJC28 ≥ 4 and SJC28 ≥ 4; inadequate response to at least one csDMARD combined with at least one bDMARD/tsDMARD.
5. For pSS: Diagnosed with pSS per 2016 ACR/EULAR classification criteria; disease duration ≥ 12 weeks and ≤ 10 years; clinESSDAI ≥ 5; positive ANA, anti-SSA/Ro, anti-SSB/La, or RF.
6. For SSc: Diagnosed with diffuse cutaneous SSc per 2013 ACR/EULAR classification criteria; disease duration ≤ 7 years; mRSS \> 10; PhGA ≥ 3.0.
7. Women of childbearing potential must agree to use highly effective contraception throughout the study period and for 3 months after the last dose.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. History of catastrophic antiphospholipid syndrome or saddle pulmonary embolism; new thromboembolic events within 1 year prior to screening; currently on anticoagulation therapy.
2. Clinically significant cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease, including decompensated heart failure (NYHA III/IV), uncontrolled severe hypertension, or severe arrhythmia.
3. Severe respiratory disease, including severe pulmonary arterial hypertension, FVC% \< 60%, or DLCOc% \< 40%.
4. History of malignancy within 5 years prior to screening (except adequately treated basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma of skin, cervical carcinoma in situ, or papillary thyroid carcinoma).
5. Active or chronic infections, including HIV infection, chronic HBV/HCV infection, latent or active tuberculosis (as applicable to study part).
6. Known hypersensitivity to QLS2416 or any of its excipients; history of severe atopic disease or anaphylaxis.
7. Prior bone marrow transplantation; prior CAR-T, CAR-NK, or T-cell engager therapy.
8. Laboratory abnormalities: hemoglobin \< 80 g/L, WBC \< 2.5×10\^9/L, ANC \< 1.0×10\^9/L, platelets \< 50×10\^9/L, ALT/AST \> 2×ULN, eGFR \< 45 mL/min/1.73m², or IgG \< 6 g/L.
9. Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
10. Major surgery within 2 months prior to screening; live vaccine within 4 weeks prior to screening.

arms.d:
Dose Escalation Part: Participants with active SLE, RA, or pSS will receive single ascending subcutaneous doses of QLS2416 injection across 7 dose levels (0.025 mg to 6.0 mg).

Dose Expansion Part: Participants with active SLE or SSc will receive multiple dosing of QLS2416 injection at 3 dose levels within the 4-week treatment period.

primary.m: Safety and Tolerability of QLS2416 Injection
